description: This file defines traits and interfaces for Hive client interactions within Spark SQL, including methods for table, database, partition, function management, and session handling.

classes.name: RawHiveTable
classes.description: Trait representing a raw Hive table with methods to access its properties and convert to CatalogTable.

classes.name: HiveClient
classes.description: Trait defining the interface for Hive client operations, including metadata management, session handling, and configuration.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the Hive version of this client.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value for a given key.

methods.name: runSqlHive
methods.description: Executes a HiveQL command, primarily for testing.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Lists all tables in a database.

methods.name: listTablesByType
methods.description: Lists tables of a specific type matching a pattern.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves a table's metadata, throws if not found.

methods.name: getRawHiveTable
methods.description: Retrieves raw Hive table, throws if not found.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific partition, throws if not found.

methods.name: getPartitionNames
methods.description: Lists partition names matching a spec.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a function, throws if not found.

methods.name: addJar
methods.description: Adds a jar to class loader.

methods.name: newSession
methods.description: Creates a new Hive client session.

methods.name: withHiveState
methods.description: Runs code within Hive state context.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metadata in the client.

methods.name: userName
methods.description: Returns the owner username for Hive tables.
